title: How Far are LLMs from Being Our Digital Twins? A Benchmark for Persona-Based Behavior Chain Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing the evaluation dataset by the publication year of the source literature and analyzing how model performance (AvgScore) degrades on newer texts to measure the impact of pre-training data familiarity.

Conducting a human validation study to measure the agreement between human judges and the GPT-4o model to assess potential cultural or personal biases introduced by using an LLM as an automated evaluator.
